fullTextZH: 你好，今天我要说一个故事。
fullTextEN: Hello, today I want to tell a story.

fullTextZH: 这个故事叫金斧头和银斧头。
fullTextEN: This story is called The Golden Axe and The Silver Axe.
A long, long time ago,
there was a little child, um,
He was a boy,
not a girl,
he was a boy.
Okay, so his family had no money,
very, very poor.

fullTextZH: 所以呢，他不可以去学校学习，
fullTextEN: So, he couldn't go to school to study,
He couldn't attend school.

fullTextZH: 他要帮家里人干活（to do labour work），对。
fullTextEN: He had to help his family with work, right.
Work, he was a child,
but he had to work.

fullTextZH: 有一天，这个小男孩他去干活，
fullTextEN: One day, this little boy went to work,
He went to chop trees,
then he went to the river to wash his hands, right.
Wash hands, but while washing his hands,

fullTextZH: 不小心他的斧头掉进了水里。
fullTextEN: accidentally his axe fell into the water.
The water was very, very deep,

fullTextZH: 所以这个小男孩看不到他的斧头。
fullTextEN: So the little boy couldn't see his axe.
He was very anxious,

fullTextZH: 很担心，因为他的家里只有一把斧头。
fullTextEN: very worried, because his family only had one axe.
So he was very worried,
So he started to cry.
Suddenly,

fullTextZH: 这条河里出现了一个老爷爷，
fullTextEN: an old man appeared in the river,

fullTextZH: 对，一个很老很老的男人。
fullTextEN: Yes, a very, very old man.

fullTextZH: 这个老爷爷看到小男孩在哭，
fullTextEN: The old man saw the little boy crying,
so he asked the little boy,
What's wrong with you?
Why are you crying?

fullTextZH: 这个小男孩一边哭一边说，哦，
fullTextEN: The little boy said while crying, oh,
My axe fell into the water,
now I can't find it.

fullTextZH: 我的爸爸妈妈一定很担心，
fullTextEN: My parents must be very worried,
What to do, what to do?
The old man said, ah,
Don't worry, don't be anxious,
I can help you look for it.

fullTextZH: 所以呢，这个老爷爷他很快沉到水里，
fullTextEN: So, the old man quickly sank into the water,
Then after a while,
he emerged again.

fullTextZH: 他手里拿着一把金斧头，对，金斧头，
fullTextEN: He was holding a golden axe in his hand, yes, a golden axe,
He asked,
Is this your axe?
Hey,
The little boy said, no,
No, not this one,
This axe is very beautiful,

fullTextZH: 我的斧头没有那么漂亮。
fullTextEN: My axe is not that beautiful.
My axe is old and worn,
The old man said, ah,
Don't worry, don't rush,
I'll go look again, right.

fullTextZH: 所以老爷爷又沉到水里，
fullTextEN: So the old man sank into the water again,
Then he searched and searched again,
After a while again,
he emerged again.

fullTextZH: 现在他拿的不是金斧头，
fullTextEN: Now he was holding not a golden axe,
He is holding a silver axe.
Then he asked the little boy,

fullTextZH: 他说，你的斧头是这把斧头吗？
fullTextEN: He said, is this axe your axe?
The little boy said, no,

fullTextZH: 不是，我的斧头也不是这把斧头。
fullTextEN: No, my axe is not this axe either.
My axe is old and worn,
not that beautiful.
My axe is not a gold axe,
nor a silver axe.

fullTextZH: 我的斧头是一把又老又旧的铁斧头。
fullTextEN: My axe is an old and worn iron axe.
The old man said, don't worry,
Don't worry, I'll look again.

fullTextZH: 终于，他找到了一把铁斧头，
fullTextEN: Finally, he found an iron axe,
Then he asked,

fullTextZH: 这把斧头是你的斧头吗？
fullTextEN: Is this axe your axe?
The little boy said, ah, yes,
This is my axe, thank you.
The old man heard this,
He was very happy,
He said,

fullTextZH: 你是一个诚实的好孩子。
fullTextEN: You are an honest and good child.
I am very happy,
So, I will give you the golden axe,
and also give you the silver axe.
The little boy was also very happy,
He took the golden axe,
the silver axe and the iron axe,
He said thank you again,
then he quickly ran home.

fullTextZH: 因为他很想告诉爸爸妈妈，
fullTextEN: Because he really wanted to tell his parents,
the story that happened today.
But,

fullTextZH: 小男孩的邻居，对，邻居听到了这个故事，
fullTextEN: The little boy's neighbor, yes, the neighbor heard this story,

fullTextZH: 他也想要金斧头和银斧头。
fullTextEN: He also wanted the golden axe and the silver axe.

fullTextZH: 所以，他想出了一个好主意。
fullTextEN: So, he came up with a good idea.
He ran to the riverside,

fullTextZH: 然后他故意把他的斧头扔到河里，
fullTextEN: then he deliberately threw his axe into the river,
then he pretended to be very sad,
He started crying loudly.
The old man appeared again,
So, the old man asked,
Hello, what's wrong with you?
Why are you crying?
This man said,

fullTextZH: 哎呀，我的斧头掉进河里了，
fullTextEN: Oh no, my axe fell into the river,
I can't find it.
The old man said, don't worry,
Don't worry, I'll help you look for it.

fullTextZH: 然后，老爷爷拿着一把金斧头问他，
fullTextEN: Then, the old man took a golden axe and asked him,

fullTextZH: 你的斧头是这把斧头吗？
fullTextEN: Is this axe your axe?

fullTextZH: 这个男的很想要金斧头，
fullTextEN: This man really wanted the golden axe,
So he said, yes, yes,
This is my axe.

fullTextZH: 说着，他就要抢这把斧头。
fullTextEN: Saying this, he tried to grab the axe.
The old man saw it,
He was very angry,

fullTextZH: 他说，你是一个不诚实的人。
fullTextEN: He said, you are a dishonest person.

fullTextZH: 所以，我不会帮你的，再见。
fullTextEN: So, I won't help you, goodbye.

fullTextZH: 所以，这个男的没有抢到金斧头，
fullTextEN: So, this man didn't get the golden axe,

fullTextZH: 而且他的铁斧头也掉进水里了。
fullTextEN: And his iron axe also fell into the water.

fullTextZH: 现在，他什么斧头都没有了。
fullTextEN: Now, he doesn't have any axe at all.
Oh dear,

fullTextZH: 可是，他真的一点也不可怜呢，对不对？
fullTextEN: But, he's really not pitiful at all, right?
Okay, this is today's story.
I hope you like this story.
Then we'll see you next time, bye.
